decision_levels.optimization_materially_helps: PASS iff the step1500-step500 paired block thresholds all pass; this label is reported independently of replacement readiness.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff capacity_and_integrity, step1500 absolute fidelity, step1500/step500 teacher-relative MSE ratio, final causality, and final predictor-only latency all pass. Otherwise NO-GO.
decision_levels.intermediate_results: Step500 and step1000 held-out metrics are descriptive after-the-fact diagnostics only; they cannot early-stop, retune, relax gates, or trigger another run.
decision_levels.non_equivalence: optimization_materially_helps PASS does not imply full_replacement GO; full_replacement GO does not require a PASS on the optimization-materially-helps attribution label if the final replacement gates pass.
